title: Add navigation link to admin dashboard

requirements.summary: Add a visible navigation link to access the admin dashboard in the Navigation component
acceptanceCriteria: A link or button labeled 'Admin' or 'Dashboard' is visible in the Navigation component
Clicking the link navigates to /admin/dashboard route
The link is accessible from all pages of the website
The link styling is consistent with other navigation items

file_operations.description: Add an 'Admin' navigation link that routes to /admin/dashboard. Place it in the desktop navigation menu alongside existing nav items and in the mobile menu. Use consistent styling with other navigation links. Ensure the link uses React Router's Link component for proper routing.
